animal_material_batches: one independently produced hypothetical batch per animal; not aliquots of one batch
limitations: All effect sizes, density and depth levels, coverage threshold and sample sizes are planning assumptions, not observed facts or approved animal procedures.
No seed searching; null/modest/plateau are scenarios, not biological conclusions.
Bench batches are independent of animal material batches. Animal and batch are analysis units.
Hashes detect accidental file changes; they do not establish the truth of any observations.
